column1: Three parts, in order. No exceptions.
Product (always first): NIAT, Intensive, Academy, Launchpad
NIAT: B1, B2, B3, B4, B5
Metric (last): full readable name, no abbreviations

Edge case: If a metric is not audience-specific, drop the audience segment. NIAT: Content Velocity: is valid. NIAT: B4: Content Velocity implies the metric varies by batch. Only use audience if that distinction is real and tracked separately.
Note: Category is not part of the KPI name. It is a classification tag. The name follows [Product] [Audience] [Metric]. The category tells you which bucket the KPI falls into.
